about: The owner's material that is NOT in the stories catalogue, as surveyed for the ceremony film on 17 Nov 2026 (scripts/build_ceremony_hires.py reads this; the survey itself is .tmp/ceremony-show/assets/candidates.md + cand_sheet_*.png). `candidates` = what may be shown, each LOOKED at (`checked`), pinned to the bytes that were looked at (`source_sha256`) and cut by the same recipe steps the stories use (crop in source pixels, post). `excluded` = why every other surveyed file is not shown (first matching rule). `surveyed` = the folders. A candidate is the picture's permission to be CONSIDERED: whether a slide may show it on a given cue is the slide validator's rule (the cue's own line must back its `about` and its baked-in `text`).
people_about: `people` (every candidate, 18 Nov review): where a real person is in the picture -- a box [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the file, with what is there -- or [] when looked at and nobody is. No `people` = not checked = the screen never gets the picture. A box is a keep-out: no slide may show it (the acts' run in Chromium checks every frame). [] where the note above already said no people; for the 33 whose note said nothing about people: 20 pictures looked at again at up to 960 px on 18 Nov, and the 8 glyphs, the two logo files, the logo clip and the clean site plan are shapes or the mark only by their own checked note. The boxes were measured at 3x-6x. `keep_out` = the same for catalogue pictures shown at full size. 18 Nov, second pass: the repo's person detector (YOLOX-nano, tiles at 1x and 2x of the full-size file) over every picture a slide names, each hit looked at by eye: c_lagoon_path (its note said no people) and the catalogue's rm_signature, liv_garden, liv_lawn and fac_g_biogenesis carry real people too -- boxed here. The detector missed the 14 px standing figure in the pavilion (found by eye): a box list is what was found, not a proof that nobody else is there.
